name: THMY Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，THMY Holdings Berhad 的公告主要涉及员工股份计划（ESOS）、股东授权及定期财报，未披露具体业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收为20,232,000令吉，净利润为6,218,000令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, THMY Holdings Berhad's announcements mainly covered the Employees' Share Option Scheme (ESOS), shareholders' mandates, and periodic financial results. No specific business segment expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts were disclosed. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) recorded revenue of MYR 20,232,000 and net profit of MYR 6,218,000.
